name: DRIP Legacy Collection
teaser: DRIP or DROWN. This collection comes as both a full download, or as parts in the description for ease of pick-and-choose as well as to assist with download times.
description_html:
Description

The legacy of DRIP continues…

Coming from the DRIP Core mod and wondering what happened to all the gear and uniforms that you love? Don’t worry, nothing’s gone! We’ve just moved all the original items and quests from DRIP into this “Legacy” pack. This includes:

  • All 200+ pieces of gear and 200+ tops/bottoms from the original mod, plus a few new ones!

  • Almost everything has new “remastered” textures, for an even more detailed and realistic look!

  • Everything has been organized to be sold between our two traders, Moron and Georgia!

  • Multiple ways to download!

    • 4.4 GB “All-in-one” package, containing all 3 parts
    • 2.15 GB “Part 1” containing essentials, with parts 2 and 3 being entirely optional

The download links for the small individual parts are located in the above tabs, and the download link for the full package is where the normal download link is.

~~~

Imgur album containing previews of everything coming soon!

Install Instructions

You must already have DRIP Core first, download here!

Instructions for the all-in-one package:

Ensure DRIP Core is installed

Download the latest version from the large blue “Download (From external URL)” button above

Extract the .zip and open the folder
Drag and drop all 3 Parts into user/mods/ColetteBlackpaw-drip/ContentPacks

Done!

Instructions for the Part 1 (Essentials) package:

Ensure DRIP Core is installed

Download at least Part 1, and optionally Parts 2 and/or 3 from the above tabs

Extract the .zip(s) and open the folder(s)

Drag and drop Part 1 (Essentials) and whichever other parts you got into user/mods/ColetteBlackpaw-drip/ContentPacks

Done!
